transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because I've been feeling extremely depressed, sad, and completely empty inside for about eight months now. It's just a constant heavy feeling that I can't seem to shake, which is why I finally decided to come in today.
During these past eight months, have you ever experienced periods where you felt unusually energetic, talkative, or impulsive, to the point where you needed much less sleep than usual?

Yes, before this low period, I had about six months where I felt overflowing with energy and barely needed any sleep. I would only sleep a couple of hours a night but still felt completely refreshed and active all day.
During those six months of high energy, did you ever need to be hospitalized, or did your behavior become so extreme that it caused serious problems at work, school, or in your relationships?
No, I don't think I was hospitalized, and I'm not really sure if it caused severe problems to that extent. Things were definitely chaotic during that time, though.
While things were chaotic, were you still able to manage your daily responsibilities at work or home, or did your behavior clearly interfere with your ability to function in those areas?

It's really hard to say because that whole period feels like a complete blur to me now. I'm not entirely sure how well I was actually managing my responsibilities, I just remember being constantly on the go.
During that high-energy period, did you ever experience anything unusual, such as hearing voices, seeing things that weren't there, or feeling like you had special powers or abilities?

Yes, during those six months of high energy, I actually heard voices that weren't there, saw strange things, and truly believed I had special powers and a grand mission. However, those experiences only happened during that high-energy phase and completely stopped once I fell into this deep depression.
Have you ever experienced these voices or strange beliefs at times when your mood was stable, or did they only occur when your energy was extremely high?

No, I've never had those experiences when my mood was normal or stable. They only ever happened during those months when my energy was through the roof and my mood was extremely high. Once that phase ended, the voices and beliefs completely stopped.
